verdict.rationale: Bedrock AgentCore marketing copy says agents built on the platform can call an MCP server, alongside knowledge bases, APIs and Lambda functions. It also says AgentCore handles authentication and access control for those connections, so AWS-hosted agents can consume external MCP tools. This is a single, glancing marketing mention with no documented configuration flow; the awslabs MCP servers are server-side and do not count toward this client story. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or connecting third-party MCP servers, details on how discovered tools are exposed to agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
